class.name: SteamInventoryChangeOperation
class.brief_description: The completion object behind an awaited inventory call.
class.description: Await the corresponding [SteamInventory] method to receive its typed terminal result. The service retains the completion object while Steam replies.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether this request has reached a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the terminal result, or [code]null[/code] while the request is pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Returns the typed terminal result immediately if available, or the completion signal to await.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after the operation settles and releases its native result handle.
